title: Canto 7: The Science of God - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 7
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 7

7.1

Title: The image of Yudhiṣṭhira talking to Nārada is from the Kalyana Kalpataru 1959.

Artist: Unknown

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, harekrsna.com

7.2

Title: The painting with the old man is titled: “Expiration”.

Artist: © Wim Kuenen (Prema, used with permission)

Source: Prema.exto.nl

7.3

Title: The drawing is titled: “Satan before the Throne of God”.

Type: ‘Illustrations to the book of Job’ (Linnell set, obj. 2).

Artist: William Blake. 1821

Source: William Blake Archive. blakearchive.org

7.4

Title: The contemporary - color adapted - painting is titled: “Mughal Court Scene”.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © Exoticindia.com, used with permission

7.5

Title: “Hiranyakasipu About to Decapitate Prahlada’’.

Type: Folio from a Bhagavata Purana (Ancient Stories of the Lord), India, Jammu and Kashmir, Mankot, South Asia, circa 1725

Source/Courtesy: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA), collectionsonline.lacma.org

7.6

Title: Vintage Hindu representation of the principle of reincarnation in relation to the Lord.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

7.7

Title: The painting of Narada giving instruction to a mother and child is titled: “Narada Muni, Mother Yashoda, Krishna and Balarama”. 18th century painting.

Artist: Unknown

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, harekrsna.com

7.8

Title: Classical painting of Nrisimhadeva slaying the demon king.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

7.9

Title: Classical painting showing Nrisimhadeva.

Artist: Johannes Ptok (Aka Janmanalaya)

Source: Consciousart gallery & ptok.se

7.10

Title: Prahlada praying is a detail of a classical painting with Nrisimhadeva.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

7.11

Title: Image of (a brahmin) is from: “A Portrait of the Hindus: Balthazar Solvyns & the European Image of India 1760-1824”.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © From the collection of prof R.L. Hardgrave, University of Texas. Used with permission.

7.12

Title: “Eight Yogis’, Number Eight of the Ishana Suit, Playing Card from a 32-Suit Dashavatara (Ten Avatars) Ganjifa Set, India, Rajasthan, Mewar, circa 1800.

Artist: Unknown

Source/Courtesy: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA), collections.lacma.org

7.13

Title: 141. Avadhuta (p. 325). “A Portrait of the Hindus: Balthazar Solvyns, Les Hindous: II.5.2. “Ab’dhoot, A Penitent Naked”.& the European Image of India 1760-1824”.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © From the collection of prof R.L. Hardgrave, University of Texas. Used with permission.

7.14

Title: “Ramayan Gayan”. ‘Solvyns, Les Hindous’: I.2.1.  Double-plate. "Rhaumien-Gauyin. Brahmuns Chanting the Exploits of Rhaum.”

Artist: Unknown

Source: © From the collection of prof R.L. Hardgrave, University of Texas. Used with permission

7.15

Title: “Seven Hindu ascetics under a banyan tree”.

By: ‘Ináyat. circa 1630, Mughal Style’.

Source: The British Museum
